Optional parallel test-name discovery was stopped after it did not clearly reduce startup delay. It did not execute test bodies and is not counted as validation. Actual Cargo tests were preserved.

The added query-count test wrapper lacked the required DbPlugin::transaction delegation. It was added; the failed build was interrupted after its compilation error and extra-final is the replacement run. Actual functional test runs were not interrupted.
